verdict.rationale: GitLab documents several first-party ways to self-host: the Linux package, official Docker images, a Helm chart and Operator for Kubernetes, self-compiling, and reference scaling configurations. Agent Platform can be turned on for Self-Managed instances, and community users confirm they run private and self-hosted instances. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the open-source license for the core (only community statements cover it), and an evidenced feature-parity statement for the AI features on self-managed versus GitLab.com.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: The Linux package includes services and tools to install GitLab without laborious configuration.
GitLab maintains a set of official Docker images based on the Linux package.
we recommend the Helm chart or the Operator for installing cloud-native GitLab.
If the Linux package isn't available for your distribution, you can self-compile GitLab.
anybody can run their own instance
